purpose: Locate source-to-stream channel reversal relative to the codec ADC
conclusion: Codec left ADC maps to stream left. Reversal occurs before ADC; workstation analog output, cable and board input wiring are not yet independently verified.

schematic_lead.observation: Manufacturer drawing dated 2019-04-09 labels J1 input pin3 left/pin4 right and J2 headphone pin3 right/pin4 left. Matching this drawing to the physical board revision is unverified.
